law_1.title: Zero-Simulation & Zero-Mock Policy
law_1.rule: No mock production security gates, authentication tokens, API responses, or system commands. Genuine deterministic local evaluation or authentic offline queue fallback.

law_2.title: Mandatory JudgeGuard Pre-Action Verification Gate
law_2.rule: Before executing any critical operation (file writes, database schema migrations, code generation, dependency changes, deployments, or git commits), the action MUST pass through judge_guard.py.

law_3.title: Work Log Traceability & State Lifecycle
law_3.rule: Every critical operation must strictly follow: 🟡 Starting -> judge_guard.py pass -> Action -> ✅ Completed -> judge_guard.py verify -> checkpoint commit.

law_4.title: Code Cleanliness, Quality & Test Discipline
law_4.rule: All code must pass test gates (pytest) and build checks before merge.

law_5.title: Anti-Circumvention, Anti-Echo & Cryptographic Execution Ticket Law
law_5.rule: Zero evasion. Work log parity enforcement. Mandatory single-use HMAC-SHA256 Execution Ticket consumption. Immediate turn halt on block without ungrounded retries.

section_46.title: Dynamic JSON Alerts (ProcessGuard Evolution)
section_46.description: Rigid halts without feedback prevent the agent from reflexive learning. The system must emit structured JSON alerts (guard_alert.json) containing severity, context, logic_hint, and actionable_fallback.

section_49.title: Timeout & Degradation Recovery
section_49.description: Graceful degradation and dynamic bounded retry to resolve transient environment or parity drift without human intervention.

SECURITY_HARD_RULE.logic_hint: Dangerous command or unauthorized root operation detected. Self-healing prohibited; manual review required.

WORK_LOG_STALE.logic_hint: WORK_LOG.md modification time exceeds 120s. Touch/append fresh heartbeat to restore freshness.

PARITY_VIOLATION.logic_hint: Action submitted to judge_guard does not match the active '🟡 Starting' entry in WORK_LOG.md. Align action string with active log state.

NO_LIFECYCLE_ENTRIES.logic_hint: No starting entries found in WORK_LOG.md. Append required '🟡 Starting <ACTION>' entry.

TEST_SUITE_FAILURE.logic_hint: Unit or integration tests failed. Diagnostics captured; code fix required.
